bowl noun

classical

Traupman 122

catīnus, catīnī m.

noun, second declension

bowl or dish

Other words

  • catillus cavus — bowl

    also used · modern · Andresian p. 5; Traupman 282; Traupman 305

    “A hollow dish”, on catillus, the small dish or plate.

  • crātēra, crātērae f. — large bowl

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Verr. 2.4.131; Liv. 5.25.10 (Lewis & Short); Andresian p. 5; Traupman 282

    Classically the bowl in which wine was mixed with water; Andresian’s large bowl. The form crātēr is mostly poetic.

See also small dish, cup, glass, jug.
